install.windows_download: Open https://x.ai/bot and choose More downloads, then Windows x64 or Arm64 matching the machine. Download the official installer and run it.
install.macos_download: Open https://x.ai/bot and choose the Apple silicon or Intel DMG. Open the DMG and drag Grok Bot to Applications.
install.linux_download: Open More downloads at https://x.ai/bot and choose the x64 or Arm64 deb, rpm or AppImage for this machine. Install with the distribution package manager, or save the AppImage under ~/Applications and make it executable.
install.note: Grok Bot is the cloud-computer agent desktop app, separate from Grok Build (the grok CLI). It uses Cursor browser sign-in. EchoBird does not configure its models. Account management uses the default user-data directory on Windows, macOS and Linux. Launch Grok Bot once to initialize its secure storage. The system keychain/keyring must be accessible; Linux basic-text storage is supported only when existing native credentials confirm that format.

install_flow.summary: Detect existing installation first; otherwise download and open the official installer, then refresh detection.
agent_steps: Detect OS and architecture. Check for an existing Grok Bot installation before downloading; do not reinstall a working client.
Use https://x.ai/bot to resolve the current official download for the detected OS and architecture. Do not install the grok CLI or third-party npm packages.
Save the installer to Downloads, report its exact path, and open it. Let the user complete any installer wizard.

Linux AppImage: save it under ~/Applications and make it executable. Register a per-user ~/.local/share/applications/grok-bot.desktop entry with Type=Application, Name=Grok Bot and Exec pointing to the absolute AppImage path (quote and escape paths containing spaces). Preserve an existing valid entry. EchoBird detects this desktop entry; downloading the AppImage alone is not a complete installation.
Refresh EchoBird tool detection and launch Grok Bot. On Windows the default executable is %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Grok Bot\Grok Bot.exe.
Sign in with the user's Cursor account. EchoBird imports existing native accounts on first use; adding an account saves it in EchoBird, and applying a selection restarts Grok Bot with that account.
Do not link SuperGrok subscriptions, change plans, change privacy settings, or modify cloud Bots as part of installation.
